Somebody's abandoned Snickers in a ziplock on a trail sign, with a note: "for a thru-hiker". Me!

nameStory.text: Day 17, around a campfire near Saddle Junction. A section hiker whose name I never got said "Sneaky Sagebrush" and everyone laughed. I didn't get the joke, but it stuck.
Day 3, around a campfire near Lake Morena County Park campground. Chris said "Soggy Badger" and everyone laughed. I didn't get the joke, but it stuck.
Did 25 miles one day before Deep Creek Hot Springs. “Wandering Sardine” rolled into camp hours after me and announced I was "Turbo" now.
I stop for every view, every flower and every lizard. Near Lake Morena County Park campground, Olivia passed me for the third time that day and named me "Feral Mango".
Day 6, around a campfire near Sunrise Hwy observation deck. A section hiker whose name I never got said "Spicy Pancake" and everyone laughed. I didn't get the joke, but it stuck.
I hike under a silver umbrella. Near Lake Morena County Park campground, Ian said I looked like a walking satellite dish. A few jokes later I was "Sir Goose".

I stop for every view, every flower and every lizard. Near Big Bear, “Electric Sagebrush” passed me for the third time that day and named me "Sloth".
In Cabazon, on my 9th zero, I ordered so much food the waitress asked if anyone was joining me. Charlie has called me "Taco" ever since.
